transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, my wife is the one who wanted me to come in. What finally scared her is that... I keep hearing things. I hear water running, and men whispering inside the walls when nobody’s there. And sometimes, I'll see this dark, wet patch spreading across the hallway floor. I'll go over and check it, but... it's always completely dry. So, she said I needed to see someone.
Have you seen things that others don't seem to see, or that aren't really there?

Yeah, like I was just saying, that's exactly what's been happening. I see that dark, wet patch spreading out on the hallway floor. It looks completely real to me, but nobody else sees it. And when I actually go down to touch it, it's bone dry. Nothing's there. 

It's the same with the sounds. I hear water running, and... I hear men whispering to each other right inside the walls. I hear them clear as day, but my wife doesn't hear a thing. That's what finally scared her enough to make me come see you.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are disorganized, or do you have beliefs that others say don’t make sense?

My thoughts don't feel disorganized to me, but... yeah, my wife says some of the things I believe don't make sense. 

I know it sounds far-fetched to anyone else, but I am certain that the mold and the wiring in our house have poisoned everything I own. I just know it has. And... I can tell the neighbors are watching me, too. They're just waiting to see when I mess up again. She tells me I'm wrong about all of it and that it doesn't make sense, but it's what I know is happening.
Do you ever feel like someone or something is controlling your thoughts or actions, or that your thoughts aren't entirely your own?

No, I don't feel like that. My thoughts are... they're my own. Nobody is putting thoughts into my head or controlling what I do. I mean, I know what's going on with the house and the neighbors, but it's just me thinking it. I'm still in control of my own mind.
